data.content:
I sent four disputes, each with your approval, covering $79.15 in deductions. The one case you should look at is DD-51102 ($46.80), which I couldn't build a case for without the order ticket.

**Sent**
| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-51152 | $28.40 | 90% | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. |
| DD-51131 | $19.00 | 77% | The ticket lists Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34. |
| DD-51115 | $17.50 | 80% | The ticket lists Jhol Momo. The order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58. |
| DD-51123 | $14.25 | 90% | The ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried). The order was ready at 18:36 and picked up at 18:40. |

- **Limits of the evidence:** The tickets and pickup times show what was prepared and handed off, not what was in the bag. The disputes say this.
- **Past disputes:** For DD-51115 I used this lesson from memory: "doordash:missing_item [pickup_handoff+1|ticket_lists_item+1] won. Ticket listing the item plus a prompt handoff time won." Two of the three similar past cases won. The loss involved a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket, and Jhol Momo is itemised.
- **No lesson applied:** For DD-51152, DD-51123 and DD-51131 the past cases didn't match the evidence, so I cited none. DD-51131 is a wrong-item claim and has no past cases.
- **Repeat claims:** One customer account has three claims this period (DD-51123, DD-51131 and DD-51140). I left that out of the disputes so they stay factual and say nothing about the customer.

**Weak: DD-51102 ($46.80, 35%)**
There is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't check the claimed Chicken Momo Party Tray against the order. Please send a photo of the ticket for that order. It is the largest deduction, so it's worth getting.

**Skipped or not reviewed**
- **DD-51171 ($11.00, 15%):** I recommend skipping it.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** Its deadline has already passed.
- **DD-51140 ($13.75) and DD-51160 ($9.50):** These ranked below the five-case limit, so I didn't review them. Both showed a 60% win probability before any evidence was checked.

**Next deadline:** 2026-11-24, 10 days from the payout load date. This applies to the DD-51102 ticket request and the two unreviewed cases.

My case notes are in `/plan.md`.
